sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Interesting! When I pressed LEFT to retract the path, the green block moved left along with the path! Looking at the current image, the green block is now right next to the player. The path retracted and brought the green block with it.
So the mechanic is: RIGHT extends the path and can "pick up" colored blocks when the path reaches them, LEFT retracts the path and brings any attached blocks back.
Now the green block is attached to the player. Looking at the bottom panel, it shows: M → R → N → b. The green block (N) is now next to the player.
Maybe I need to collect blocks in order and place them somewhere? Or maybe I need to arrange them in the correct order?
Let me check the bottom panel to see if it changed after collecting the green block.

print("\n=== After UP ===")
